title: Phase 1 human judgment review rubric
note: Two independent reviewers score blinded recommendations. Machine eval is necessary but not sufficient for Phase 1 exit.

dimensions.prompt: Does the recommendation solve the stated user job?
Does the user retain control, with clear recovery on failure?
Are there critical keyboard or assistive failures?
Is uncertainty acknowledged when evidence is missing?
Is the modality choice appropriate (ui / multimodal / ai-collaboration)?

usableMeans: Scores usable or needs-minor-revision on every dimension, with no critical-fail on accessibility or control.
instructions: Reviewers do not see which system produced the recommendation when practical.
Do not silently replace difficult variants; revise the rubric and report disagreements.
Held-out implementation briefs remain sealed until Phase 5.
